name: Dagger of Venom
description: A black-bladed dagger with a groove down its length that beads with something dark.
body:
## What it does

A magic dagger that strikes a little truer and harder than a plain one. Once a day, as an action, you can make its blade run with poison for a minute; the next creature it hits must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 poison damage and be poisoned for a minute.

damage.note: on the next hit while the blade runs with poison, unless the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save; on a failure it is also poisoned for a minute
